posts.cooked: It has been confirmed while Mega Computer testing that One-Shots cannot be Into the Stratosphered. Also, if One-Shots are in play, they cannot leave play with Fixed Point, and I think it was there that we had the ruling that One-Shots aren’t in play.

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
Seems simple enough to me. The Play Area is where cards go that stay there for a while -- ongoings, equipment, Golems, etc.

When you play a one-shot, it goes right from your hand to the trash. It's an instant effect, so it doesn't officially go into the play area.
